summary: Big Spencer Mountain lookout near Moosehead Lake: wood tower from 1906 or 1916, steel tower with cab in 1927, cab removed 2009. Tower stands unattended; hiking trail.

facts.design: Steel tower with cab completed in 1927 per the photo inventory; a 14-foot wood tower was listed in 1920
facts.status_note: Tower still stands, but its cab was removed in December 2009

access.note: Public reserved land in a state ecological reserve, open to hiking, hunting and birding (NRCM). No closure notice found. Summit equipment is privately owned.

visit.trail_note: Maine Trail Finder lists the round trip at 4 miles; rough and eroding in places, with short ladders on the upper trail

events.note: Photo inventory: Maine Forestry District established a wood tower. A 1916 newspaper item describes the work in a way that competes with this date, so the first build date is disputed
Daily Kennebec Journal item by a man who says he helped build the tower
Tower painted inside and out, with wooden shutters placed on it
Photo inventory: a 12-foot steel tower with cab completed; crews had hauled steel for it in December 1926
Kennebec Journal item: Fred Chadwick of Dover-Foxcroft to man the tower; visitors may hike the trail to the top
NRCM says the tower was active for nearly 85 years, until 1991; Maine Atlas ties the end of the state network to a 1991 budget crisis
Cab removed from the tower in December 2009

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The photo inventory and the 1907 Forest Leaves item date the first station to 1906; a 1916 Daily Kennebec Journal item by a writer who says he helped build the tower competes with that date. The story reports both and does not pick one.
NRCM gives the parcel as 4,242 acres; Maine Trail Finder gives 4,244. The story says about 4,240.

notes_for_editor: Build date is disputed (1906 photo inventory vs 1916 newspaper item). Most of the early history comes from the Forest Lookouts page, which quotes old reports and photo inventories; the originals were not checked. Trail Finder's body text calls the trail remote 2-mile, but its length field says 4.00 miles round trip; the story says 4 miles as listed. Two Facebook items seen only as search snippets, not read: a 1967 'Big Spencer Mountain' post saying the tower came down over the 1966-67 winter, and a post saying the cab blew off in a December 2009 storm. Both conflict with the Forest Lookouts account and are not used. No closure notice found; the story does not encourage climbing.
